params.body:
Phase 1, step 6a of `docs/design/sources-before-more-sources.md`. The screen
itself follows in Trendwolves/gentells-dashboard.

`GET /collection`, behind the staff gate like every other ops read, gives the
Sources page what the app already says to Elixir: every adapter with its
declaration and its standing, what is switched off and why, and the orphans.

**One function behind both**, so the screen and the judge can never read two
different truths. A test pins that the two answers are equal.

Standings gain what a person on a screen wants and a judge does not need:
platform, vendor, description, the **names** of the keys an adapter needs and
what a run costs. Never a key's value, and a test says so.

It does not judge here either. How long is too long is Elixir's to say.

774 tests pass, 3 new.
params.title: The Observatory can ask where the adapters stand
